description: AlicePET OS launcher for CardputerZero: boot screen, Navi home with Alice, and the chip folder.

store.summary: Personal terminal home screen with Alice, your Navi companion, and a browsable battle chip folder.
store.description: AlicePET OS v0.1 is the first real app for CardputerZero. It shows a P.E.T. boot screen that connects to Navi over Tailscale, then opens the NAVI HOME screen where Alice greets you. Press [2] to open the CHIP FOLDER, browse seven battle chips with the arrow keys, and press ENTER to slot one. Battle combat is not built yet; the slotted screen currently reads 'Coming soon'.
